 IHH Healthcare streamlines back office for more integration 
 About 380 of the workforce will be laid off.  
 IHH Healthcare is consolidating its business support services to build a more integrated operating foundation for the group. 
 It also aims to unlock synergies across its network and invest resources where they create the greatest impact, according to a press release.
 As part of the move, some employees will move into redesigned roles, whilst 380 of the workforce will be laid off.
 The group said these changes do not affect clinical services, healthcare professionals or patient-facing teams.
